name: Zynaps: objgrid
summary: The free-slot search, the collision grid and the jump-table dispatch.

entries.name: FindFreeObjectSlot
entries.summary: find a free record among the 16 from $F36C (unused)

entries.name: MarkEnemyGrid
entries.summary: mark the 8 enemy slots' collision bits in the grid

entries.name: TestHitGrid
entries.summary: the overlap masks of the player, the shots and the weapons

entries.name: JumpTable
entries.summary: jump to the word number A of the table at HL

labels.name: FindFreeSlotLoop
labels.comment: active: the next record

labels.name: FindFreeSlotDone
labels.comment: NC: IY free; carry: none

labels.name: MarkGridObject
labels.comment: the next slot: skip unless active and visible

labels.name: MarkGridColumns
labels.comment: the bit into every 4th X byte, one a column of the width

labels.name: MarkGridSkipRows
labels.comment: leading rows outside the row mask: not marked

labels.name: MarkGridRowLoop
labels.comment: the next row: in the mask?

labels.name: MarkGridRow
labels.comment: the bit into the Y byte of this row

labels.name: MarkGridLastRow
labels.comment: the last Y byte of the object

labels.name: MarkGridNextObject
labels.comment: the next slot's bit

labels.name: MarkGridRestoreSp
labels.comment: SP back (the operand written at $90CB)

labels.name: MarkGridRowOff
labels.comment: a row outside the mask: step over it

labels.name: TestGridObject
labels.comment: the next record: the descriptor and its width

labels.name: TestGridWidth
labels.comment: the X position into the X bytes at $FC00

labels.name: TestGridColumns
labels.comment: OR of 4 X bytes a column

labels.name: TestGridRows
labels.comment: OR of the Y bytes over the height
+$0D: the enemies this record overlaps
only the player and the four lasers count for $80BB, and only when active

labels.name: TestGridNext
labels.comment: the next record: 44 bytes on ($018C for the first step)
$80BB: the hit mask of the player and the lasers

labels.name: TestGridRestoreSp
labels.comment: SP back (the operand written at $9150)

labels.name: ClearGridLoop
labels.comment: 10 words a pass

labels.name: ClearGridRestoreSp
labels.comment: SP back (the operand written at $91C6)
